tokens.v: First article inspection, FAI, checks that production meets the engineering and specification requirements, to avoid scrap or rework later. It applies to orders from production, purchase and purchase schedules, and sales. Rules decide when an order needs one; releasing such an order makes an FAI number, and the receipt is blocked in warehousing until Quality inspects and processes it. A full FAI is for a new product; a partial one reports only the changed feature or process.
